account.title: What We Hold On Every Account
account.lede: Not a list of names. A profile of an account you are trying to take, across 70+ fields in six groups.
account.fit: Accounts run 50 to 5,000 employees and 10M to 250M in revenue, the band where switching actually happens. The average PEO client carries 23.2 worksite employees, so this sits well above the industry median.

faq.title: Questions We Hear On The First Call
faq.sub: Short answers first. The detail is there if you want it.

items.q: What would this actually change for my team?
items.lead: Your reps stop opening calls blind.
items.detail: They know the incumbent, the size of the account, who signed it and what else runs alongside it, before they dial. Displacement pitches land differently when you can name the provider the prospect is already paying.

items.q: Where does this data come from?
items.lead: Public records, professional profiles and opt in sources, each traceable to a source category.
items.detail: Public filings and business registries, company websites and careers pages, professional profiles and submitted resumes, event and webinar registrations, opt in surveys, and partner and recruitment networks. We will document provenance for any field you ask about before you buy. Processing follows GDPR, CCPA and CAN SPAM requirements, and opt out requests are honoured.

items.q: Can you tell me when a contract renews?
items.lead: Where it is observable, yes. Where it is not, we say so rather than guess.
items.detail: Most of the value sits elsewhere: knowing the incumbent lets you time your own outreach against the provider's renewal season instead of calling at random.

items.q: Can I see a sample first?
items.lead: Yes, once we understand what you are building.
items.detail: A scoped sample is there to show you the framework, which attributes come with an account and how they are structured, rather than as a free batch of leads. Teams that start with the briefing get to a usable file faster than teams that start with a download.

items.lead: Revenue leaders selling into PEO and EOR accounts.
items.detail: At PEO and EOR providers running displacement campaigns, and at HRIS, HCM, payroll, benefits administration and insurance brokerage firms selling into the same accounts. Typically a CRO, VP of sales, head of growth or demand generation director.
